title: Resolution urging Albany to make Kwanzaa a state holiday
summary: This resolution calls on the New York State Legislature to pass, and the Governor to sign, legislation designating Kwanzaa as a public holiday in New York. Kwanzaa is a seven-day African American and Pan-African celebration running from December 26 to January 1. Similar state bills were introduced in the Assembly in January 2023 and the Senate in January 2024.
